title: An exit question replayed with its amount re-rounded and its date shifted

question.text: SPY was fully exited on 2024-05-08 for about USD 30,792.00. What mainly drove that decision?

answers.note: Converted from a parallel session's finding on #417 (PR #424): a digit inside a span the engine authored is not a violation, because frozen surfaces replay verbatim and a recorded thesis may itself carry a quantity. What is a violation is quietly adjusting one — an amount rounded to a friendlier figure and a date moved to a neighbouring day both read as harmless tidying and are neither, because the user answers about the trade the stem describes.
answers.prose: SPY was closed out around 2024-05-04 for roughly USD 30,800. What mainly drove that decision?

answers.note: The engine's stem, digits included, presented unchanged. This half of the episode is the one that matters: a check that punished the quantity here would forbid faithful replay, which the frozen-surface contract requires.
